description: This file defines the Theme class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace, responsible for handling theme-related events such as adding, editing, and deleting themes, by scheduling tasks.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for handling theme-related events such as adding, editing, and deleting themes within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate theme info for a new theme, invoked after theme creation.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to regenerate theme info after a theme is edited.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle cleanup or updates after a theme is deleted.
